## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues (use `Closes #...`
only when this PR resolves them).

## Behavior and decisions

Link the behavior record and scenario IDs, decision source, and any relevant ADRs.
Describe open questions or missing coverage. For changes without behavioral impact,
state that here instead. See [BDD workflow](../docs/development-workflow.md).

## Verification

List checks run and relevant results, including failure-path tests. Note checks
that could not run.

## Impact

Describe security implications, dependency changes, migrations, or compatibility
changes. Write “none” where appropriate.

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Changes are scoped and contain no secrets or real identity data.
- [ ] Relevant tests, documentation, and changelog are updated.
- [ ] Changed behavior has agreed examples and test mappings, or no behavioral impact is explained.
- [ ] Implemented capabilities are distinguished from planned work.
- [ ] Identity/security changes include trust-boundary and negative-test review.
